findings.title: CNSC-1 skip
findings.description: Secrets are injected at runtime

findings.title: CNSC-2 skip
findings.description: Applications and workloads are explicitly authorized to communicate with each other using mutual authentication

findings.title: CNSC-3 skip
findings.description: Keys are rotated frequently

findings.title: CNSC-4 skip
findings.description: Key lifespan is short

findings.title: CNSC-5 skip
findings.description: Credentials and keys protecting sensitive workloads (health/finance/etc) are generated and managed independent of a cloud service provider

findings.title: CNSC-6 skip
findings.description: Authentication and authorization are determined independently

findings.title: CNSC-7 skip
findings.description: Authentication and authorization are enforced independently

findings.title: CNSC-8 skip
findings.description: Access control and file permissions are updated in real-time

findings.title: CNSC-9 skip
findings.description: Authorization for workloads is granted based on attributes and roles/permissions previously assigned

findings.title: CNSC-10 skip
findings.description: ABAC and RBAC are used

findings.title: CNSC-11 skip
findings.description: End user identity is capable of being accepted, consumed, and forwarded on for contextual or dynamic authorization

findings.title: CNSC-12 skip
findings.description: All cluster and workloads operators are authenticated

findings.title: CNSC-13 skip
findings.description: Cluster and workloads operate actions are evaluated against access control policies governing context, purpose, and output

findings.title: CNSC-14 skip
findings.description: Identity federation uses multi-factor authentication

findings.title: CNSC-15 skip
findings.description: HSMs are used to physically protect cryptographic secrets with an encryption key residing in the HSM

findings.title: CNSC-16 skip
findings.description: Secrets should have a short expiration period or time to live

findings.title: CNSC-17 skip
findings.description: Time to live and expiration period on secrets is verified to prevent reuse

findings.title: CNSC-18 skip
findings.description: Secrets management systems are highly available

findings.title: CNSC-19 skip
findings.description: Long-lived secrets adhere to periodic rotation and revocation

findings.title: CNSC-20 skip
findings.description: Secrets are distributed through secured communication channels protected commensurate with the level of access or data they are protecting

findings.title: CNSC-21 skip
findings.description: Secrets injected at runtime are masked or dropped from logs, audit, or system dumps

findings.title: CNSC-22 skip
findings.description: Bootstrapping is employed to verify correct physical and logical location of compute

findings.title: CNSC-23 skip
findings.description: Disparate data sensitive workloads are not run on the same host OS kernel

findings.title: CNSC-24 skip
findings.description: Monitor and detect any changes to the initial configurations made in runtime

findings.title: CNSC-25 skip
findings.description: API auditing is enabled with a filter for a specific set of API Groups or verbs

findings.title: CNSC-26 skip
findings.description: Container specific operating systems are in use

findings.title: CNSC-27 skip
findings.description: The hardware root of trust is based in a Trusted Platform Module (TPM) or virtual TPM (vTPM)

findings.title: CNSC-28 skip
findings.description: Minimize administrative access to the control plane

findings.title: CNSC-29 skip
findings.description: Object level and resource requests and limits are controlled through cgroups
